title: QA workflow result
description: The one record either workflow produces. A run that has not reached QA Verification yet is a legitimate, honest partial record — qaVerification.verdict is PENDING, and finalResult is not computed until every stage has a verdict. A tool that fills PENDING in with PASS to make the record look complete has reintroduced the exact defect this contract exists to prevent.

workflow.description: Which of the two workflows produced this record.

id.description: Ticket ID for workflow=ticket (e.g. PROJ-1234); suite/tag name for workflow=regression.

commit.description: Short SHA the run was taken against.

finalResult.description: Worst-of the three stage verdicts, in the order FAIL > BLOCKED > PENDING > PASS. PENDING means qaVerification has not been recorded yet — a consumer must treat PENDING exactly like a missing result, never like a pass.

evidencePath.description: Repo-relative path to the durable evidence this verdict was read from.

id.description: Case ID, per core/e2e-engine-contract.md's ID convention.

engine.description: Optional. Which engine produced this case, e.g. 'playwright' or 'claude-in-chrome' — see core/e2e-engine-contract.md §8 and core/case-result.schema.json. Omitted for older records or engines that predate this field; absence is not a violation.

reviewer.description: Identity of the independent verifier. Must not equal the authoring commit's identity — see core/jira-workflow-contract.md, independence rule.
